sourceScope: non-notification CI repairs; final release freeze owned by root

cases.scenario: Scoped model validation intercepts malformed local selections before the existing checker, dropping field names and established effort/unknown-control messages.
cases.fix: Keep the strict schema and format the same actionable rejection contract; no provider/controller dispatch on invalid requests.
cases.proof: 6 new failures before, 21 checker tests and 3 real HTTP regressions pass after.

cases.scenario: Approval timing hook still targets claude.ts after broker extraction, so approval-clock fixtures exit before health readiness.
cases.fix: Target exact claude-permission-broker.ts timer seam; no production permission behavior changed.

cases.scenario: Late-completion fixture silently replaces an event fan-out loop no longer in claude.ts, so completionheld is never written.
cases.fix: Hook claude-turn-events.ts exact fan-out and fail explicitly if that seam changes.
cases.proof: All 4 replacement-generation scenarios and full 44-case VM suite pass.

cases.scenario: Cleanup VM fixture omits sharedAgents.cancelHosted now used by interruptDirectThread, so deferred adapter-start promises never resolve.
cases.fix: Supply inert hosted-cancellation dependency in the fixture; 15 cleanup tests pass.

cases.scenario: Synthetic Codex config/read invents an unrelated native MCP server unless instructed to honor its -c overrides; guest configuration gate correctly refuses before turn/start.
cases.fix: Enable existing fake override behavior in the Cloud fixture; shell-disable and empty-environment assertions remain.

cases.scenario: Legacy guest test expects a Bash approval card, while hardened confinement correctly denies Bash at the broker before any card.
cases.fix: Require explicit system denial and no card, both before and after an owner saves a matching command; no production guard relaxed.

fullCloudIsolation.blocker: Local Windows file-symlink creation lacks privilege; EPERM at cloud-lending-memory.e2e.test.ts:415. Original CI031 passed this exact case; assertions retained.

limits: Local Windows isolated fixtures; Linux CI awaits final exact-source workflow.
Notification, delegation and thread-selection semantics are owned by the other agent.
